rationale: The description states conventional privacy-compliance workflows, including access or erasure requests, consent changes, storage, and download links. It also says the platform automates identity verification without explaining whether that is rules-based or AI-dependent, so the non-AI decision is weak and forced.
evidence_spans: helps organizations streamline access or erasure requests and consent changes across every data system
The platform automates identity verification, stores personal data and creates downloadable links for end-users.
conflict_response: The labeler and blind proposals both selected non-AI but differed on support strength. The parent concern specifically identifies unexplained identity-verification automation as potentially AI-dependent; without its method, the conventional workflow interpretation cannot be a supported negative, so the final label is weak and forced.
